TOBI is a project lead by the ETH Library and co-funded by swissuniversities. It aims to evaluate the quality of open bibliometric data sources regarding research affiliated with Swiss Higher Education Institutions. The project has started in early 2023 and ended in July 2025.


## News

#### Publication: Recommendations for Swiss Higher Education Institutions to enhance the visibility of their research output
*30.06.2025*  
We are glad to announce the publication of a set of 14 recommendations for Swiss Higher Education Institutions to enhance the visibility of their research output:

- Willemin, S., Bachmann, M., Muheim, C., Foulger, S., Friedlein, S., Guignard, A., Haller, M., Hauf, N., Hirschmann, B., Kubacka, T., Nunnenmacher, L., Pinardi, L., Pruschak, G., Schneble, C., & Stieger, R. (2025). *Recommendations for Swiss Higher Education Institutions to enhance the visibility of their research output*. ETH Library, ETH Zurich. [https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-b-000735240](https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-b-000735240)

This recommendation paper has been written in collaboration with contributors from eight Swiss higher education institutions and research organizations. It provides ideas and use cases that address various aspects of metadata improvement and metadata dissemination in local repositories, global platforms, and beyond.  
The recommendation paper is available in the [ETH Research Collection](https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-b-000735240) and on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/records/15774309).


#### TOBI Portfolio on GitHub
*05.05.2025*  
We are happy to share that the TOBI Portfolio is now available on GitHub. This collection of Jupyter Notebooks supports the use of open bibliometric data sources in higher education. The tools provided are designed to help with data cleaning and analysis. You can explore the portfolio [here](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi-portfolio).


#### Publication: Swiss Institutions in Bibliometric Databases
*13.03.2025*  
As a continuation of our earlier blogposts, we have published an English paper in the journal *Qualität in der Wissenschaft*:

- Dederke, J., Koch, M., & Willemin, S. (2024). The Representation of Swiss Higher Education Institutions in Five Bibliometric Databases. *Qualität in der Wissenschaft*, 2024(4), 117-124, [https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-b-000726102](https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-b-000726102)

Underlying the paper are data on publication counts for all Swiss Higher Education Institutions in five bibliometric databases. These data are available at:

- Koch, M., Dederke, J., & Willemin, S. (2024). Publication counts for Swiss Higher Education Institutions in five bibliometric databases (2012-2022), [https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-b-000694041](https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-b-000694041)

In addition to the dataset, the files include figures that present the counts for different publication types across all Swiss Higher Education Institutions:

- [Article counts by institution](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/publication/Article_Counts_by_Institution_2012-2022.pdf) (2012-2022)
- [Book counts by institution](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/publication/Book_Counts_by_Institution_2012-2022.pdf) (2012-2022)
- [Chapter counts by institution](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/publication/Chapter_Counts_by_Institution_2012-2022.pdf) (2012-2022)
- [Conference paper counts by institution](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/publication/Conference_Paper_Counts_by_Institution_2012-2022.pdf) (2012-2022)

#### Blogpost: Swiss Higher Education Institutions in Bibliometric Databases
*08.07.2024*  
Our latest [blogpost](https://yearofscientometrics.ethz.ch/exploring-swiss-higher-education-institutions-in-commercial-and-open-bibliometric-databases) explores the visibility of Swiss higher education institutions (HEIs) in both commercial and open bibliometric databases. As a continuation of a [previous blogpost](https://yearofscientometrics.ethz.ch/swissuniversities-institutions-in-commercial-databases) on the findability of HEIs across commercial databases, we pursue the analysis by investigating open databases. Our analyses reveals that OpenAlex, OpenAIRE as well as the commercial database Dimensions are more inclusive compared to the commercial and established databases Scopus and Web of Science when it comes to the findability of HEIs. Open databases also report higher publication counts than commercial databases for major institutions, while more variability is observed for smaller institutions. These results as well as the benefits of working with community-driven data curation are discussed.  
Supplementary file:

- Full list of Swiss higher education institutions found across databases: [.pdf file](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/blogpost/20240528_list_swissuniversities_institutions_found_in_commercial_and_open_databases.pdf)

#### Blogpost: Swiss Higher Education Institutions in Commercial Bibliometric Databases
*10.04.2024*  
Our new [blogpost](https://yearofscientometrics.ethz.ch/swissuniversities-institutions-in-commercial-databases) covers the main findings and implications of a study of Swiss higher education institutions' findability in commercial bibliometric databases. Knowing how Switzerland is represented in these established, commercial databases will later allow a point of comparison for OpenAlex and OpenAIRE within the TOBI project. The blogpost underscores the relevance of organisational identifiers and language disambiguation for the findability and visibility of Swiss HEIs in bibliometric databases. It also showcases the widely varying publication counts across commercial bibliometric databases.  
Supplementary files:

- Full list of Swiss higher education institutions found in commercial database webapps: [.pdf file](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/blogpost/20240202_list_swissuniversities_institutions_found_in_commercial_database_webapps.pdf), [.csv file](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/blogpost/20240327_list_swissuniversities_institutions_found_in_commercial_database_webapps.csv)
- List of institutions included for “ETH Zurich” in Dimensions, Scopus, WoS: [.pdf file](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/blogpost/20240327_table_commercial_database_identifiers_URLs_eth_example.pdf)
- List of search queries for Swiss higher education institutions in commercial database webapps (including child- and related-institutions): [.csv file](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/blogpost/20240410_df_queries_commercial-dbs.csv), [.xlsx file](https://github.com/eth-library/tobi/raw/main/reports/blogpost/20240410_df_queries_commercial-dbs.xlsx)

#### Third Swiss Year of Scientometrics (SYoS) Workshop
*23.02.2024*  
The third workshop of the Swiss Year of Scientometrics (SYoS) on 8 February 2024 at EPFL was a success. The workshop opened with three lightning talks on TOBI, on the Swiss Open Access Monitor (NOAM) and on the French Open Science Monitor, and was followed by stimulating discussions on open data and responsible research assessment. Presentations related to SYoS are available on the [Zenodo page of the project](https://zenodo.org/communities/syos). We are thankful to the workshop participants for their rich input, as well as to the organizing team of the event at EPFL.


#### Upcoming: Third Swiss Year of Scientometrics (SYoS) Workshop
*16.01.2024*  
The [third workshop](https://yearofscientometrics.ethz.ch/mc-events/syos-workshop-no-3) of the Swiss Year of Scientometrics (SYoS) will take place on 8 February 2024 at EPFL in Lausanne. The workshop will start with lightning talks on open data projects. Participants will then discuss questions related to data pipelines, sustainability, and infrastructure. The output of the workshop will be used as a basis for a TOBI report.
